apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: Preferred authentication method for UniFi OS controllers. Provide a token generated from the controller's user settings.

useLocalCredentials.title: Use Local Credentials
useLocalCredentials.description: Force username/password authentication (for local administrator accounts) even when an API key is present.

includeRuleIndexes.title: Include Rule Indexes
includeRuleIndexes.description: Optional list of firewall rule indexes to expose. When omitted, all rules are eligible unless explicitly excluded or hidden.

excludeRuleIndexes.title: Exclude Rule Indexes
excludeRuleIndexes.description: Firewall rule indexes to ignore (even if they would otherwise be included).

hiddenRuleIndexes.title: Hidden Rule Indexes
hiddenRuleIndexes.description: Firewall rule indexes to hide from Homebridge while keeping them available for discovery summaries.

customNames.title: Custom Rule Names
customNames.description: Map of firewall rule index to the name that should be displayed in Homebridge. Defaults to the controller rule name.

name.title: Name
name.placeholder: Name to give the switch in Homebridge
